title: Felix and the Extraction
premise: Cyrus Crane, a disgraced intelligence analyst now working deniable cases, is pulled into a global conspiracy when a dead informant's voiceprint unlocks a server revealing a staged catastrophe planned to look like an industrial accident. As she traces the plot through shell companies and inherited fortunes, she discovers the attack is the legacy project of a dynasty laundering its sins into public tragedy — and that the person who summoned her is the heir trying to stop his own family. Hunted by the conspirators and abandoned by every agency that once discarded her, Cyrus must choose between restoring her name through official channels that will bury the truth, or delivering justice outside the law. In the end she exposes the dynasty by turning its own inheritance against it, but at the cost of her last clean identity, vanishing into the deniable world she once escaped.
about_author: Vesper Yarrow is the pen name of a former risk consultant who spent a decade advising firms on crises they hoped would never make the news. They write from a coastal town whose name they decline to confirm.

chapters.title: The Unwanted File
chapters.summary: Cyrus Crane's POV. Broke and blacklisted after three agency dismissals, Cyrus takes a low-grade case verifying a dead whistleblower's estate. The emotional beat is weary resignation — she has learned to expect nothing from anyone, including herself.

chapters.title: A Voice from the Dark
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. While digitizing the dead man's effects she finds a voice recording; played against an old server, it unlocks a hidden archive on a foreign host. The beat is reluctant curiosity curdling into dread as the files name a date six weeks out.

chapters.title: What the Server Knows
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. The archive maps a planned industrial disaster engineered to destroy evidence of a dynasty's crimes. The beat is cold clarity: this is the kind of truth that got her fired the first time.

chapters.title: The Heir Who Called
chapters.summary: Julian Voss's POV, first appearance. The dynasty's estranged grandson reveals he planted the voiceprint to summon an outsider no one would suspect. His beat is terrified resolve — he is betraying his own blood.

chapters.title: Terms of Deniability
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Julian offers payment and protection she doesn't trust; she negotiates access to the family archives instead of money. The beat is guarded bargain-hunting between two people who cannot afford to trust.

chapters.title: House of Voss
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. A family gathering at the Voss estate; his grandfather Augustin watches him too closely. The beat is the suffocating warmth of belonging that costs everything.

chapters.title: Paper Trails
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. She traces shell companies linking the Voss foundation to the target facility. The beat is the hunter's pleasure of a pattern emerging — her first competence-high in years.

chapters.title: Old Colleagues
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. She risks a discreet query to a former agency contact, Mara, and gets a warning instead of help: someone else is asking about the same file. The beat is loneliness sharpened into paranoia.

chapters.title: The Cleaner
chapters.summary: Antagonist POV, first appearance. A professional fixer named Sable is assigned to find the leak. The beat is professional calm — menace without heat.

chapters.title: Six Weeks
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. She decodes the attack timeline and realizes the 'accident' is scheduled during a safety inspection designed to provide cover. The beat is the vertigo of a clock starting.

chapters.title: Inheritance
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. He finds his father's old ledgers showing the family fortune was built on the very facility now marked for destruction. The beat is grief for a childhood that was a lie.

chapters.title: Safehouse Rules
chapters.summary: Cyrus and Julian share scenes. They set up a workroom; friction over methods — his caution, her ruthlessness. The beat is grudging respect taking root.

chapters.title: The First Tail
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. She spots surveillance in the city and runs a counter-follow, confirming Sable's team. The beat is adrenaline and the old self waking up.

chapters.title: Mara's Price
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Mara agrees to verify one document off the record, but demands Cyrus explain why she was really fired. The beat is a wound reopened — the past as debt.

chapters.title: What Cyrus Did
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter, Cyrus's POV. The third dismissal: she refused to bury a friendly-government atrocity and was made the scapegoat. The beat is bitter self-knowledge; justice outside the law is her only country.

chapters.title: The Inspection Team
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. He maneuvers to be assigned to the facility inspection that will provide the attack's cover, placing himself inside the blast radius. The beat is self-sacrifice disguised as duty.

chapters.title: Sable Closes
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. The fixer identifies Cyrus and reports to Augustin Voss, who orders her handled quietly. The beat is the chill of being a line item in someone else's ledger.

chapters.title: Break-In
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. She penetrates a Voss subsidiary's records office and photographs the transfer schedules, tripping a silent alarm. The beat is triumph curdling into exposure.

chapters.title: Run
chapters.summary: Cyrus and Julian POV alternating. The safehouse is burned; they flee across the city in a night of close calls. The beat is fear fused with a new, dangerous loyalty.

chapters.title: The Middle of It
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Cornered, she calls Mara, who extracts them — revealing Mara has been running her own quiet investigation into Voss for years. The beat is the shock of discovering she was never as alone as she believed.

chapters.title: Two Investigations, One Truth
chapters.summary: Cyrus, Julian, Mara planning. Mara's evidence fills Cyrus's gaps; the attack will kill the inspection team and pin the blame on a subcontractor — Julian's own cover identity. The beat is horror: Julian was meant to die in it.

chapters.title: Augustin's Testament
chapters.summary: Augustin Voss's POV, first appearance. He reflects on the family's sins and frames the attack as inheritance maintenance. The beat is banal evil — conviction without cruelty.

chapters.title: The Leak Inside
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Someone in Mara's circle is feeding Sable; a trusted analyst is turned. The beat is betrayal — the circle was never closed.

chapters.title: Interrogation of a Ghost
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. She and Mara trap the mole and turn him, learning the attack date moved up by nine days. The beat is a race now run at a sprint.

chapters.title: Nine Days
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. Inside the facility as an inspector, Julian maps the sabotage points and smuggles out schematics. The beat is claustrophobic courage.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.summary: Augustin's POV. Augustin offers Cyrus full reinstatement and her record cleared if she delivers Julian and the files. The beat is temptation with her old self hanging on the hook.

chapters.title: What a Name Is Worth
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. She stalls Augustin while deciding, and understands the offer is a lie — her record will be cleared only posthumously. The beat is clarity; the law was never going to have her back.

chapters.title: Countermove
chapters.summary: Cyrus, Mara, Julian. They plan to trigger the facility's real safety systems early, forcing a public shutdown that makes the 'accident' impossible and the cover-up visible. The beat is hope with teeth.

chapters.title: Sable's Mistake
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Ordered to eliminate Cyrus before the inspection, Sable walks into the mole-turned-double's trap. The beat is the hunter hunted; Sable's composure cracks for the first time.

chapters.title: What Sable Knows
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Interrogating Sable yields the final piece: Augustin's personal authorization, recorded in his own vault. The beat is grim satisfaction and the weight of what must be done.

chapters.title: The Vault
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. Julian returns to the estate under pretext and copies the vault's authorization ledger — his inheritance, weaponized. The beat is the son finally choosing what to inherit.

chapters.title: Fracture
chapters.summary: Cyrus and Julian. Augustin confronts Julian with evidence of his betrayal; Julian escapes wounded. The beat is heartbreak — the family door closing forever.

chapters.title: Countdown
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Two days out; the team scatters into position while Sable's replacement hunts them. The beat is exhausted focus, everyone past fear into purpose.

chapters.title: Inspection Day
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs converging. The sabotage begins; Cyrus infiltrates the control room as Julian stalls the inspection schedule. The beat is white-knuckle tension.

chapters.title: The Accident That Wasn't
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. She forces the safety shutdown and triggers alarms across the region, making the staged disaster impossible to hide. The beat is ferocious triumph mid-chaos.

chapters.title: Augustin's Fall
chapters.summary: Augustin's POV. With the facility sealed and the ledger public, Augustin's board turns on him; he faces his dynasty's end. The beat is the quiet collapse of inherited power.

chapters.title: The Price of the Ledger
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Officialdom moves to contain the story; Mara's evidence is seized, and Cyrus's role must be erased to protect the mole network. The beat is injustice as the cost of victory.

chapters.title: Justice, Unattributed
chapters.summary: Cyrus and Julian. They release the vault ledger through channels no agency controls; the truth lands without a name attached to it. The beat is bittersweet vindication — the work matters even if she doesn't get credit.

chapters.title: What She Inherits
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Julian offers her a place in what remains of his world; Mara offers a place in hers. Cyrus realizes the belonging she chased in institutions was always going to be found in people. The beat is quiet warmth.

chapters.title: Felix and the Extraction
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV, closing. Revealed: Felix was the whistleblower's name, and the voiceprint was his final extraction — of her. Cyrus burns her last clean identity and walks into a new case, unattributed and unafraid. The beat is release: she was never bounced; she was freed.
